Enhance checkout process with total amount calculation and shipping cost integration

- Added total amount calculation before placing an order in the checkout screen.
- Updated the order creation method to include shipping cost parameters.
- Modified success dialog to display the correct total amount after order placement.

Update CI workflow to run tests without coverage

- Modified the test command in `firebase-hosting-merge.yml` to run `flutter test` without the coverage flag, simplifying the testing process in the CI pipeline.

Add PWA support and update meta tags for improved web app experience

- Integrated PWAInstallButton in catalog and home screens for easier app installation.
- Updated index.html with enhanced meta tags for better SEO and mobile compatibility.
- Revised manifest.json to reflect the new app name, description, and added categories for improved PWA functionality.

Refactor order model tests to simplify creation and validation

- Removed complex object creation in order tests for clarity.
- Added a new test for basic order creation and status validation.
- Streamlined the test structure to focus on essential properties and enum values.

Refactor Order model and tests for improved clarity and functionality

- Cleaned up the Order model code for better readability and consistency.
- Updated the test cases to validate basic properties and enum values of the Order model.
- Ensured that the toMap/fromMap methods maintain data integrity without complex serialization.

Update CI workflows to suppress fatal analysis warnings and improve Firestore data handling

- Modified the `flutter analyze` command in both `firebase-hosting-merge.yml` and `firebase-hosting-pull-request.yml` to include the `--no-fatal-infos` flag, allowing the CI to continue running despite non-fatal issues.
- Updated Firestore data retrieval in `firestore_service.dart` to remove explicit type casting for better flexibility.
- Cleaned up import statements in `order_service_test.dart` to streamline test dependencies.

Refactor product and cart screen logic for improved error handling and UI consistency

- Added debug logging for stock and date parsing errors in the Product model.
- Updated cart screen initialization to ensure the cart loads only when the widget is mounted.
- Refactored button widgets in the cart screen for consistent styling and structure.

Update format check in CI workflows to provide clearer error messaging

- Modified the format check command in both `firebase-hosting-merge.yml` and `firebase-hosting-pull-request.yml` to include a message prompting users to run `dart format .` locally if formatting issues are detected.
Format code and update CI workflows with tests and coverage

Update GitHub workflows to use Dart for formatting checks

- Changed the format check command in both `firebase-hosting-merge.yml` and `firebase-hosting-pull-request.yml` from `flutter format` to `dart format` for consistency and improved compatibility.

Update dependencies and refactor GitHub workflows for improved CI/CD

- Added `provider` package to manage state across the application.
- Updated `pubspec.lock` to include new dependencies for `nested` and `provider`.
- Refactored GitHub Actions workflows to enhance testing and deployment processes, including code formatting, analysis, and test coverage reporting.
- Removed unused `simple_routes.dart` and `product_service.dart` files to streamline the codebase.
- Integrated ViewModel architecture in various screens for better state management and separation of concerns.

Refactor order and product models for improved date handling and enhance checkout and orders screens

- Updated date handling in `Order` and `Product` models to use milliseconds since epoch for `createdAt` and `updatedAt`.
- Enhanced `CheckoutScreen` to create orders with improved error handling and user feedback.
- Implemented loading and empty states in `OrdersScreen`, allowing users to view their order history with status indicators.

Refactor Google Sign-In handling for improved user experience

- Enhanced the Google Sign-In flow by adding conditional logic for web and mobile platforms.
- Implemented a popup sign-in method for web users using Firebase Authentication.
- Maintained the existing sign-in process for mobile users with the GoogleSignIn instance.

Enhance Google Sign-In flow for web and mobile platforms

- Added conditional logic to handle Google Sign-In differently for web and mobile platforms.
- Implemented sign-in with popup for web users using Firebase Authentication.
- Maintained existing authentication flow for mobile users with GoogleSignIn instance.

Update dependencies and enhance authentication flow

- Updated `Podfile.lock` to include new dependencies for Firebase and other packages.
- Added `firebase_auth` and `shared_preferences_foundation` to the project.
- Enhanced routing and authentication handling in `routes.dart` with a new `GoRouterRefreshStream` class.
- Improved user experience with custom page transitions and authentication guards.
- Updated various screens to integrate Firebase authentication and improve UI elements.
- Refactored product management and cart functionalities for better performance and usability.

Integrate Firebase Authentication and update dependencies

- Added `firebase_auth` dependency in `pubspec.yaml` with version 6.0.2.
- Updated `pubspec.lock` to include Firebase Authentication packages: `firebase_auth`, `firebase_auth_platform_interface`, and `firebase_auth_web`.
- Modified iOS Podfile.lock to include Firebase Authentication pods and their dependencies.
- Implemented Firebase initialization and authentication flow in `main.dart`, including email/password and Google sign-in methods.
- Updated `Info.plist` with OAuth client details for Google Sign-In.
- Registered Firebase Authentication plugin in macOS and Windows generated plugin registrants.

Update dependencies and integrate Google Sign-In support

- Added `google_sign_in` dependency in `pubspec.yaml` with version 7.1.1.
- Updated `pubspec.lock` to include new Google Sign-In related packages: `google_sign_in`, `google_sign_in_android`, `google_sign_in_ios`, and others.
- Updated iOS Podfile.lock to include necessary Google Sign-In pods and their dependencies.
- Registered Google Sign-In plugin in macOS generated plugin registrant.

Update Google services configuration for Android and iOS

- Added OAuth client details to `google-services.json` for Android.
- Updated `GoogleService-Info.plist` for iOS with new client ID and reversed client ID.

Update iOS deployment target to 15.0 and integrate CocoaPods framework support

- Changed the iOS platform version in Podfile and AppFrameworkInfo.plist from 13.0 to 15.0.
- Added necessary Pods framework references in the Xcode project file.
- Updated build configurations to use new Pods-related xcconfig files for better dependency management.

Update dependencies and integrate Firebase Core plugin

- Added `firebase_core` dependency in `pubspec.yaml` with version 4.1.0.
- Updated `pubspec.lock` to include new Firebase-related packages: `firebase_core`, `firebase_core_platform_interface`, `firebase_core_web`, and `plugin_platform_interface`.
- Configured Android build files to include Google services for Firebase.
- Updated iOS and macOS configuration files to include necessary Pod support files.
- Registered Firebase Core plugin in both macOS and Windows generated plugin registrants.
Add new security configuration for Strapi media subdomain in next.config.ts

Enhance cleanupCompletedBulkImports function in brightdata_scraper.js to delete associated CSV files before removing bulk import records. Update API call to include CSV file data in the fetch request, improving resource management and ensuring proper cleanup of completed imports.

Update scraping status terminology in brightdata_scraper.js and implement cleanup for completed bulk imports. Change 'done' to 'scraped' for clarity in status updates, and add a new function to delete completed bulk imports if no alumni are pending, enhancing resource management.

Refactor updateAlumnusStatus function in brightdata_scraper.js to streamline error handling and improve logging. Ensure robust handling of status updates during scraping process, enhancing overall reliability.

Implement detailed alumni update logic in brightdata_scraper.js, including error handling and photo upload functionality. Enhance logging for successful updates and errors during the process, improving overall robustness of the scraping workflow.
Enhance LinkedIn URL extraction logic in brightdata_scraper.js by adding a check for undefined URLs, ensuring more robust handling of profile data during status updates.

Update dependencies in package.json and package-lock.json, add esbuild as a devDependency, and remove Docker-related files from the cms app. Enhance TypeScript configuration for better compatibility and include new content types in generated definitions.

Update bulk import lifecycle to dynamically retrieve the port for API calls, enhancing compatibility with different environments. Introduce a delay before triggering the import process to ensure stability, while improving logging to include the port information.

Refactor bulk import controller to consolidate processing logic, enhancing clarity and maintainability. Migrate process functionality from a separate file into the main controller, improving error handling and logging. Update route configuration to reflect the new handler structure and ensure proper API integration.

Refactor bulk import lifecycle to trigger processing via an API call, simplifying the asynchronous handling of document imports. Remove CSV parsing and database interactions from the lifecycle, enhancing performance and reducing transaction conflicts. Improve error logging for failed triggers.

Refactor bulk import lifecycle to utilize setImmediate for asynchronous processing, enhancing stability and avoiding transaction conflicts. Improve error handling and logging, including clearer messaging for import status and record processing. Update LinkedIn URL extraction logic for better accuracy.

Refactor bulk import lifecycle to utilize setTimeout for asynchronous processing, ensuring transaction completion before import begins. Enhance error handling and logging, including improved fallback mechanisms for LinkedIn URL extraction and CSV record parsing. Update final report messaging for clarity.

Refactor bulk import and alumnus schemas to rename 'status' fields to 'importStatus' and 'scrapingStatus' respectively, enhancing clarity and consistency. Update lifecycle logic to accommodate these changes and improve error handling during import processes.
